description: This source file defines the CopierGenerator class responsible for generating deep and shallow copy classes for serializable types within the Orleans code generation framework. It includes methods for creating copier classes, handling base types, generating copy methods, and managing copier fields and serialization hooks.

classes.name: CopierGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating copier classes for serializable types, including deep copy and shallow copy implementations, handling base types, and managing serialization hooks within the Orleans code generation framework.

classes.name: CopierGenerator.BaseCopierFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a base type copier field used internally in copier class generation.

classes.name: CopierGenerator.CopierFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a copier field with associated underlying type, used for injecting or referencing copiers during code generation.

methods.name: GenerateCopier
methods.description: Generates a copier class for a given serializable type, including deep copy logic, base type handling, and serialization hooks.

methods.name: GetSimpleClassName
methods.description: Returns a simplified class name for the copier class based on the serializable type's name.

methods.name: GetFieldDeclarations
methods.description: Creates field declarations for the copier class based on provided field descriptions.

methods.name: GenerateConstructor
methods.description: Generates a constructor for the copier class, initializing copier fields and handling special cases like exception types.

methods.name: GetBaseTypeField
methods.description: Determines the base type copier field description for a serializable type.

methods.name: GetCopierFieldDescriptions
methods.description: Collects copier field descriptions for members that require copying, avoiding static and shallow copyables.

methods.name: GenerateMemberwiseDeepCopyMethod
methods.description: Creates a method that performs a memberwise deep copy of a serializable type.

methods.name: GenerateMemberwiseCopy
methods.description: Generates code to copy each member from source to destination, invoking appropriate copiers.

methods.name: GenerateMemberCopy
methods.description: Generates code to copy a single member, using either static or injected copiers.

methods.name: AddSerializationCallbacks
methods.description: Adds serialization hook method calls to the copy process based on serialization hooks defined in the type.
